items.item_text: Current, active California Registered Nurse License
BLS from American Red Cross or American Heart Association
3 years of recent acute care or ambulatory experience

In this role you will be responsible for assisting with clinical management and administrative coordination of the department including both the Extensivist and Addiction Medicine program including various Internal Medicine Subspecialties as needed.  The position is a combination of clinical (direct care) and administrative responsibilities.
BSN from an accredited school of nursing
developing a plan of care including setting goals, monitoring and documenting progress
implementing interventions that are pertinent to goals established in the plan of care
evaluating the effective of interventions toward the attainment of established goals and
recognizing the need to reassess or reset goal parameter
Ability to lead with behaviors, actions, and language to reflect conscious commitment to supporting unit, department, and hospital vision
Ability to project a calm, reassuring and confident manner and promote a cohesive team environment
Ability to consistently achieve high standards in clinical duties and hold self to same standards as others are held to
Ability to make decisions in the best interest of the patient
Skill to effectively listen and communicate to peers both positive and constructive feedback
Able to admit fault and acknowledge others’ position without becoming defensive
Skill to consistently use good judgment in making decisions
Ability to consistently identify opportunities to improve unit performance and takes action to implement ideas
Skill to develop rapport with patients and patients families
Ability to recognize (or bring attention to) peers’ accomplishments
Ability to maintain positive attitude towards unit and work, helping to build unit’s positive reputation
Ability to consistently model right behaviors
Skills in coaching and assisting staff in:
